character_limit.description: Maximum number of characters allowed for a UOM name when used on commitment line items, expressed as a numeric string (e.g., `"32"`). Null when the ERP integration imposes no character limit, or when no integration is connected.

erp_integration_name.description: Short display name of the company's connected ERP integration (e.g., `Sage 300 CRE`). Empty string when no ERP integration is connected.

get.description: Returns the Units of Measure (UOMs) configured for the company, grouped by UOM Category. Includes both Procore-provided standard UOMs (those with `is_standard: true`, e.g., `hours`, `sf`) and any custom UOMs defined by the company. Pass `view=ids_only` to return only the IDs. parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Serialization view. When set to `ids_only`, the response body is a JSON array of integer Unit of Measure IDs (pagination headers still apply). Omit for the default view (full UOM objects grouped by category).

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Restrict results to UOMs with one or more matching IDs. Example: `filters[id]=[101,102]`.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]

patch.description: Creates, updates, and/or deletes a batch of Units of Measure (UOMs) for the company in a single call. Each entry in `updates` is treated as a create when `id` is omitted, or as an update when `id` is supplied. IDs in `deletes` remove the matching UOMs; standard (Procore-provided) UOMs cannot be deleted via this endpoint and will be reported in the response `errors` array. Only company admins can call this endpoint. See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

updates.description: UOMs to create or update. Omit `id` to create a new custom UOM; supply `id` to update an existing UOM. For Procore-provided standard UOMs, only `name` can be updated; `uom_category_id` changes are silently ignored.

id.description: ID of an existing Unit of Measure to update. Omit when creating a new UOM.

name.description: Display name of the UOM (e.g., `hours`, `sf`). Required when creating; optional on updates. Must be unique within the company and cannot match a Procore standard UOM name.

uom_category_id.description: ID of the parent UOM Category from `GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uom_categories`. Required when creating; optional on updates.

deletes.description: IDs of custom UOMs to delete. Standard (Procore-provided) UOMs cannot be deleted via this endpoint and will be reported in the response `errors` array.

items.description: ID of a custom Unit of Measure to delete.

is_standard.description: True when this UOM is one of Procore's built-in standard units (e.g., `hours`, `sf`, `ls`); standard UOMs cannot be deleted, and only `name` can be modified. False for company-defined custom UOMs.

name.description: Display name of the UOM (e.g., `hours`, `sf`, `ls`). Returned localized for the requesting user. Unique per company.

description.description: Human-readable label for the UOM (e.g., `Lump Sum`). Present and localized only for Procore standard UOMs; null for company-defined custom UOMs.

uom_category.description: The UOM Category this UOM belongs to.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the UOM Category. Use as the `uom_category_id` when creating or updating a Unit of Measure.

name.description: Name of the UOM Category. One of Procore's standard categories: `time`, `amount`, `length`, `area`, `volume`, `mass`, `other`. Returned localized for the requesting user.

items.description: A single failed entry returned by `PATCH /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uoms/sync`. Contains the original UOM payload alongside an `errors` map keyed by field name explaining why the row failed validation (e.g., name conflicts, missing category, attempting to delete a standard UOM).

id.description: ID of the Unit of Measure that failed to sync (echoed from the request).

is_standard.description: True when the failed row references a Procore-provided standard UOM. Standard UOMs cannot be deleted via sync, and `uom_category_id` cannot be changed; only `name` can be modified.

name.description: Name from the failed UOM payload (echoed from the request).

description.description: Human-readable label for the UOM. Present only for Procore standard UOMs; null for custom UOMs.

uom_category.description: The UOM Category associated with the failed UOM, if available.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the UOM Category.

name.description: Name of the UOM Category. One of Procore's standard categories: `time`, `amount`, `length`, `area`, `volume`, `mass`, `other`.

errors.description: Validation errors keyed by field name. Each value is an array of human-readable error messages. The `base` key holds row-level errors not tied to a specific field (e.g., attempting to delete a Procore-provided standard UOM via the `deletes` array).

field_name.description: Example error array for a single field. Replace `field_name` with the actual offending field key returned at runtime.
